verdict.rationale: Driver openness is a fair question for a GPU, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only OS support (DGX OS 7 on Ubuntu 24.04, RHEL, Rocky Linux). That is host-platform compatibility, not evidence of open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux driver support. Nothing in the pack mentions an open driver for the B300.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
